status.note: Every setting in this document is an [AGENT] proposal for a calculation that has not been run; it is not a measured capability, not a readiness claim, and not an authorization.

system.note_nuclei: Within a job the nuclei never move, so no fixed-atom or optimizer setting applies.
system.note_angstrom: Angstrom values are for orientation only, converted with the CODATA 2022 Bohr radius [51].

energy_convention.E_elec: E_elec excludes V_NN and includes electron kinetic energy.
energy_convention.V_NN: V_NN = 1/R hartree, with R in bohr.
energy_convention.reported_quantities: Each run records the engine's reported total energy and the engine's reported nuclear repulsion separately.
energy_convention.engine_total_meaning: OPEN until shown for the exact build: which energy the engine's reported total is.
energy_convention.E_elec_derivation: E_elec is derived only after the engine's total is shown for the exact build.

electronic_model.reason: [50] shows one contracted s function per H, so H2 has two basis functions and the variational space can be counted by hand; this makes no claim that STO-3G is the smallest standard basis.

A.note: 1.4 bohr is a round value chosen for transparent arithmetic; it is not an equilibrium, not a target, and not an expected minimum.

B.requires: Only after Phase A has been run under its own authorization and independently reviewed, and only with a person's separate authorization of Phase B.
B.note: H2-B-03 repeats 1.4 bohr as a separate job. The lowest point on the grid is a grid minimum only; no interpolation or fitting is performed.

reference.basis_for_choice: [AGENT] RHF chosen as the reference for a closed-shell singlet with identical alpha and beta densities [48, Spin/Symmetry Treatment]
reference.version_evidence: OPEN: semantics not yet shown for the exact H2 build

basis.version_evidence: PARTIAL: installed basis bytes not established for the H2 build [31]

resource_bounds.wall_note: [AGENT] enforced by the driver, not the engine

stop_conditions: SCF not converged or iteration limit reached
any reported identity mismatch: engine version or build, method, reference, basis, charge, multiplicity, electron count, basis-function count, atom count, coordinates, units
reported nuclear repulsion differing from 1/R by more than 1e-10 hartree, a geometry and unit integrity check only
any network access or installation attempt
rule: stop the sequence, keep all output, mark remaining points NOT_RUN, change no setting
